original_test_intent: Run rocHPL performance stress for the authoritative approved duration, then prove the defined ECC status/counter for the same GPU is zero or has zero new-error delta through the specified secure management interface.
original_method: Resolve duration conflict, pin rocHPL/ROCm/GPU topology and data set, capture pre-load ECC/SEL/MCE/log baselines, run bounded target-complete rocHPL under independent thermal/power/watchdog monitoring, then securely issue and decode the exact raw IPMI query, correlate with ROCm and system evidence, compare approved counter/status semantics to zero and verify recovery.
manual_activity: GPU/BMC/performance owner resolves duration and ECC oracle, approves rocHPL load and secure raw path and owns any new-error disposition and verdict.
required_inputs: Approved authoritative duration resolving Procedure versus machine-time field
Signed rocHPL/ROCm/ipmitool versions, data set/config and stable GPU map
Vendor raw response schema and zero/status/counter-delta rule
Secure BMC credential/endpoint mapping, long-run limits, watchdog and recovery
safety_requirements: Never copy embedded admin credentials/fixed endpoint
Capture counters before load and preserve lifetime semantics
Abort on limit, reset, workload error, new uncorrected event or management anomaly
Stop cleanly, preserve evidence and never clear counters/logs or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Await duration/oracle decision and validate artifacts/targets
Capture baseline and run one approved bounded rocHPL workload
Securely collect/decode post-load ECC and correlated evidence
Verify recovery and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve rocHPL config and ECC raw-field/zero/delta semantics
Disposition nonzero/preexisting/new errors and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It only reads an ECC view, omits rocHPL and changes the source interface using unsafe remote access.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After duration approval, run the pinned rocHPL config for that exact interval; then issue the vendor-confirmed raw bytes securely and retain rocm-smi/SEL/MCE as corroboration, not substitution.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 24-hour Procedure and ten-minute machine-time conflict are both retained pending decision; raw byte tuple remains exact and plaintext connection values are not executable.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind monotonic workload duration and per-GPU utilization to before/after raw ECC byte decodes plus ROCm/SEL/MCE deltas and independent telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the load, duration and zero result attributable and secure without collapsing the raw source into a generic ECC read.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An ECC read without rocHPL, or a ten-minute run when 24 hours is authoritative, cannot satisfy this case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Lifetime counters may be nonzero before test; acceptance must specify absolute zero versus zero new errors and which counter classes matter.

project_override_considerations: Performance owner defines data set and target utilization; reliability owner decides authoritative duration and ECC counter classes without rewriting the Master in this review.
expected_evidence: Approved duration decision, tool/config/data hashes and stable GPU/BMC identities
Pre-load raw ECC decode, ROCm/SEL/MCE/log baseline
Exact rocHPL argv/config, full output, elapsed time and per-GPU utilization/performance
Independent thermal/power/watchdog trace and stop/abort record
Post-load raw bytes/decode plus pre/post ECC/status/counter-delta and corroborating logs
Post-health, credential-redaction audit, disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items/Procedure explicitly require a 24-hour performance test, while machine-time metadata says ten minutes; the source does not establish which duration governs execution.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The conflict is preserved for engineering decision while static review and subsequent cases continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row238 Wistron-AMD GPU-00231-V002: decide whether rocHPL duration is the Procedure's 24 hours, the machine-time field's 10 minutes, or separately named checkpoints; approve exact workload/config and whether raw ECC `0x06 0x52 0x01 0xac 0x02 0xef 0x1a` must be absolute zero or zero new delta, with field/endian/schema and ROCm/SEL corroboration.

review_improvement: Restores the defining rocHPL endurance load, exposes the duration conflict, secures raw ECC collection and defines baseline/delta evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Reading ECC after no load cannot validate error-free compute stress. Duration changes exposure materially, so the 24-hour/ten-minute mismatch cannot be normalized silently. A raw zero is meaningless without field semantics and may conflict with preexisting lifetime counters; before/after deltas bound causality. Target-complete utilization is also required because rocHPL can run successfully while leaving a GPU idle due to configuration error.
